split_strategy: stratified by category on unique descriptions
fit_boundary: All learned transformations (TF-IDF vocabulary, label encoding, model parameters) are fitted on the TRAIN split only. Valid and test are only transformed. Text normalization is stateless and therefore leakage-safe.
leakage_controls: De-duplicated to one row per unique description BEFORE splitting, so no identical string can appear in both train and test.
Identifier tokens (store numbers, ZIPs, PPD/reference IDs) replaced with <num> so the model cannot key on per-transaction random codes.
